mapper.select: SELECT s.status AS status, s.direction AS direction, s.position_qty AS position_qty, s.pending_action AS pending_action, s.pending_idempotency_key AS pending_idempotency_key, s.unsafe_recovery AS unsafe_recovery FROM quant_strategy_position_state s JOIN quant_strategy_instance i ON i.id=s.instance_id JOIN quant_strategy_symbol b ON b.id=i.strategy_symbol_id JOIN quant_symbol q ON q.id=b.symbol_id WHERE s.instance_id=#{instanceId} AND i.credential_id=#{credentialId} AND i.strategy_id=#{strategyId} AND q.symbol=#{symbol}
